````typescript
 1: import React, { useState } from 'react'
 2: 
 3: const ERROR_IMG_SRC =
 4:   'data:image/svg+xml;base64,'
 5: 
 6: export function ImageWithFallback(props: React.ImgHTMLAttributes<HTMLImageElement>) {
 7:   const [didError, setDidError] = useState(false)
 8: 
 9:   const handleError = () => {
10:     setDidError(true)
11:   }
12: 
13:   const { src, alt, style, className, ...rest } = props
14: 
15:   return didError ? (
16:     <div
17:       className={`inline-block bg-gray-100 text-center align-middle ${className ?? ''}`}
18:       style={style}
19:     >
20:       <div className="flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full">
21:         <img src={ERROR_IMG_SRC} alt="Error loading image" {...rest} data-original-url={src} />
22:       </div>
23:     </div>
24:   ) : (
25:     <img src={src} alt={alt} className={className} style={style} {...rest} onError={handleError} />
26:   )
27: }
````

226: function ParticleTextSection() {
227:   const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
228: 
229:   useEffect(() => {
230:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
231:     if (!canvas) return;
232:     const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
233:     if (!ctx) return;
234: 
235:     let animationId: number;
236:     const particles: {
237:       x: number;
238:       y: number;
239:       baseX: number;
240:       baseY: number;
241:       size: number;
242:       vx: number;
243:       vy: number;
244:     }[] = [];
245: 
246:     const resize = () => {
247:       canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth * 2;
248:       canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight * 2;
249:       ctx.scale(2, 2);
250:       initParticles();
251:     };
252: 
253:     const initParticles = () => {
254:       particles.length = 0;
255:       const w = canvas.offsetWidth;
256:       const h = canvas.offsetHeight;
257: 
258:       ctx.fillStyle = "#F2F0EB";
259:       ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(w / 8, 80)}px 'Cormorant Garamond', serif`;
260:       ctx.textAlign = "center";
261:       ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
262:       ctx.fillText("ENZO INTERIORS", w / 2, h / 2);
263: 
264:       const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
265:       const step = 4;
266: 
267:       for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += step) {
268:         for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += step) {
269:           const i = (y * canvas.width + x) * 4;
270:           if (imageData.data[i + 3] > 128) {
271:             particles.push({
272:               x: x / 2,
273:               y: y / 2,
274:               baseX: x / 2,
275:               baseY: y / 2,
276:               size: 1.5,
277:               vx: 0,
278:               vy: 0,
279:             });
280:           }
281:         }
282:       }
283:     };
284: 
285:     let mouseX = -1000;
286:     let mouseY = -1000;
287: 
288:     const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
289:       const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
290:       mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
291:       mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;
292:     };
293: 
294:     const handleMouseLeave = () => {
295:       mouseX = -1000;
296:       mouseY = -1000;
297:     };
298: 
299:     const animate = () => {
300:       ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.offsetWidth, canvas.offsetHeight);
301:       ctx.fillStyle = "#8A9E8C";
302: 
303:       for (const p of particles) {
304:         const dx = mouseX - p.x;
305:         const dy = mouseY - p.y;
306:         const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
307:         const force = Math.max(0, 80 - dist) / 80;
308: 
309:         if (force > 0) {
310:           p.vx -= (dx / dist) * force * 3;
311:           p.vy -= (dy / dist) * force * 3;
312:         }
313: 
314:         p.vx += (p.baseX - p.x) * 0.05;
315:         p.vy += (p.baseY - p.y) * 0.05;
316:         p.vx *= 0.85;
317:         p.vy *= 0.85;
318:         p.x += p.vx;
319:         p.y += p.vy;
320: 
321:         ctx.beginPath();
322:         ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
323:         ctx.fill();
324:       }
325: 
326:       animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
327:     };
328: 
329:     resize();
330:     animate();
331: 
332:     canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", handleMouseMove);
333:     canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", handleMouseLeave);
334: 
335:     let resizeTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
336:     const debouncedResize = () => {
337:       clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
338:       resizeTimer = setTimeout(resize, 200);
339:     };
340:     window.addEventListener("resize", debouncedResize);
341: 
342:     return () => {
343:       cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
344:       canvas.removeEventListener("mousemove", handleMouseMove);
345:       canvas.removeEventListener("mouseleave", handleMouseLeave);
346:       window.removeEventListener("resize", debouncedResize);
347:       clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
348:     };
349:   }, []);
350: 
351:   return (
352:     <section className="bg-[#1C4A3A] py-12">
353:       <canvas
354:         ref={canvasRef}
355:         className="w-full h-[250px] md:h-[350px] cursor-crosshair"
356:       />
357:     </section>
358:   );
359: }
````

185:           className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[8px] text-white ${darkMode ? "bg-[#4A8C5C]" : "bg-[#1C4A3A]"}`}
186:         >
187:           {project.avatar}
188:         </div>
189:         <span className={`text-[11px] ${t2}`}>{project.client}</span>
190:       </div>
191:       <p className={`text-[13px] ${t1}`} style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
192:         {project.name}
193:       </p>
194:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-3">
195:         <span
196:           className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] ${darkMode ? "bg-[#2A2A28] text-[#8A8A82]" : "bg-[#EAE7E0] text-[#6B6B65]"}`}
197:         >
198:           {project.service}
199:         </span>
200:         {project.days > 0 && (
201:           <span className={`text-[10px] ${t2}`}>{project.days}d in stage</span>
202:         )}
203:       </div>
204:     </motion.div>
205:   );
206: }

208: interface DroppableColumnProps {
209:   stage: string;
210:   projects: Project[];
211:   darkMode: boolean;
212:   onDrop: (projectId: number, newStage: string) => void;
213:   onCardClick: (project: Project) => void;
214: }
215: 
216: function DroppableColumn({
217:   stage,
218:   projects,
219:   darkMode,
220:   onDrop,
221:   onCardClick,
222: }: DroppableColumnProps) {
223:   const [{ isOver }, drop] = useDrop(() => ({
224:     accept: "PROJECT",
225:     drop: (item: { id: number; stage: string }) => {
226:       if (item.stage !== stage) {
227:         onDrop(item.id, stage);
228:       }
229:     },
230:     collect: (monitor) => ({
231:       isOver: monitor.isOver(),
232:     }),
233:   }));
234: 
235:   const t1 = darkMode ? "text-[#F0EEE9]" : "text-[#1E1E1C]";
236: 
237:   return (
238:     <div
239:       ref={drop}
240:       className={`min-w-[260px] flex-shrink-0 rounded-2xl border p-4 transition-all ${isOver ? "ring-2 ring-[#4A8C5C]" : ""} ${darkMode ? "bg-[#1C1C1A] border-[#2A2A28]" : "bg-white border-[#C4B8A8]/20"}`}
241:     >
242:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
243:         <span className={`text-[12px] ${t1}`} style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
244:           {stage}
245:         </span>
246:         <span
247:           className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${darkMode ? "bg-[#2A2A28] text-[#8A8A82]" : "bg-[#EAE7E0] text-[#6B6B65]"}`}
248:         >
249:           {projects.length}
250:         </span>
251:       </div>
252:       <div
253:         className={`space-y-3 min-h-[100px] transition-colors ${isOver ? (darkMode ? "bg-[#4A8C5C]/10 rounded-lg p-1" : "bg-[#1C4A3A]/5 rounded-lg p-1") : ""}`}
254:       >
255:         {projects.map((p, i) => (
256:           <DraggableCard
257:             key={p.id}
258:             project={p}
259:             darkMode={darkMode}
260:             onClick={() => onCardClick(p)}
261:             index={i}
262:           />
263:         ))}
264:       </div>
265:     </div>
266:   );
267: }

40:           <motion.div
41:             initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
42:             animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
43:             exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
44:             onClick={onClose}
45:             className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm z-[60] md:hidden"
46:           />
47: 
48:           {/* Bottom Sheet */}
49:           <motion.div
50:             initial={{ y: "100%" }}
51:             animate={{ y: 0 }}
52:             exit={{ y: "100%" }}
53:             transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 30, stiffness: 300 }}
54:             className={`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 ${bg} rounded-t-3xl z-[70] md:hidden max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col`}
55:           >
56:             {/* Handle */}
57:             <div className="flex justify-center pt-3 pb-2">
58:               <div
59:                 className={`w-10 h-1 rounded-full ${darkMode ? "bg-[#2A2A28]" : "bg-[#C4B8A8]/30"}`}
60:               />
61:             </div>
62: 
63:             {/* Header */}
64:             <div
65:               className={`flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b ${darkMode ? "border-[#2A2A28]" : "border-[#C4B8A8]/20"}`}
66:             >
67:               <h3 className={`text-[16px] font-semibold ${textPrimary}`}>
68:                 {title}
69:               </h3>
70:               <button
71:                 onClick={onClose}
72:                 className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${darkMode ? "hover:bg-[#2A2A28]" : "hover:bg-[#F5F4F0]"}`}
73:               >
74:                 <X size={18} className={textSecondary} />
75:               </button>
76:             </div>
77: 
78:             {/* Content */}
79:             <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">{children}</div>
80:           </motion.div>
81:         </>
82:       )}
83:     </AnimatePresence>

## File: src/app/components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx
````typescript
  1: import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
  2: import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "motion/react";
  3: import {
  4:   X,
  5:   Search,
  6:   File,
  7:   User,
  8:   DollarSign,
  9:   MessageCircle,
 10:   Calendar,
 11:   Star,
 12:   ChevronRight,
 13: } from "lucide-react";
 14: import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
 15: import { searchData, SearchResult } from "../../data/mockData";
 16: 
 17: interface CommandPaletteProps {
 18:   darkMode: boolean;
 19:   isOpen: boolean;
 20:   onClose: () => void;
 21: }
 22: 
 23: const typeIcons = {
 24:   client: User,
 25:   project: File,
 26:   invoice: DollarSign,
 27:   message: MessageCircle,
 28:   booking: Calendar,
 29:   testimonial: Star,
 30: };
 31: 
 32: const typeColors = {
 33:   client: "text-blue-500",
 34:   project: "text-green-500",
 35:   invoice: "text-amber-500",
 36:   message: "text-purple-500",
 37:   booking: "text-pink-500",
 38:   testimonial: "text-yellow-500",
 39: };
 40: 
 41: export function CommandPalette({
 42:   darkMode,
 43:   isOpen,
 44:   onClose,
 45: }: CommandPaletteProps) {
 46:   const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
 47:   const [results, setResults] = useState<SearchResult[]>([]);
 48:   const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(0);
 49:   const navigate = useNavigate();
 50:   const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
 51: 
 52:   const c = darkMode
 53:     ? "bg-[#1C1C1A] border-[#2A2A28]"
 54:     : "bg-white border-[#C4B8A8]/20";
 55:   const t1 = darkMode ? "text-[#F0EEE9]" : "text-[#1E1E1C]";
 56:   const t2 = darkMode ? "text-[#8A8A82]" : "text-[#6B6B65]";
 57:   const hover = darkMode ? "hover:bg-[#2A2A28]" : "hover:bg-[#F5F4F0]";
 58:   const selected = darkMode ? "bg-[#2A2A28]" : "bg-[#F5F4F0]";
 59: 
 60:   // Focus input when modal opens
 61:   useEffect(() => {
 62:     if (isOpen && inputRef.current) {
 63:       inputRef.current.focus();
 64:     }
 65:   }, [isOpen]);
 66: 
 67:   // Reset state when modal closes
 68:   useEffect(() => {
 69:     if (!isOpen) {
 70:       setQuery("");
 71:       setResults([]);
 72:       setSelectedIndex(0);
 73:     }
 74:   }, [isOpen]);
 75: 
 76:   // Update results when query changes
 77:   useEffect(() => {
 78:     if (query.trim()) {
 79:       const searchResults = searchData(query);
 80:       setResults(searchResults.slice(0, 8)); // Limit to 8 results
 81:       setSelectedIndex(0);
 82:     } else {
 83:       setResults([]);
 84:       setSelectedIndex(0);
 85:     }
 86:   }, [query]);
 87: 
 88:   // Keyboard navigation
 89:   useEffect(() => {
 90:     const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
 91:       if (!isOpen) return;
 92: 
 93:       if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
 94:         e.preventDefault();
 95:         setSelectedIndex((prev) => Math.min(prev + 1, results.length - 1));
 96:       } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
 97:         e.preventDefault();
 98:         setSelectedIndex((prev) => Math.max(prev - 1, 0));
 99:       } else if (e.key === "Enter" && results.length > 0) {
100:         e.preventDefault();
101:         handleSelect(results[selectedIndex]);
102:       } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
103:         onClose();
104:       }
105:     };
106: 
107:     window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
108:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
109:   }, [isOpen, results, selectedIndex, onClose]);
110: 
111:   const handleSelect = (result: SearchResult) => {
112:     navigate(result.url);
113:     onClose();
114:   };
115: 
116:   if (!isOpen) return null;
117: 
118:   return (
119:     <AnimatePresence>
120:       <motion.div
121:         initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
122:         animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
123:         exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
124:         className="fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md flex items-start justify-center pt-[15vh] p-4"
125:         onClick={onClose}
126:       >
127:         <motion.div
128:           initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
129:           animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
130:           exit={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
131:           className={`${c} border rounded-2xl w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl`}
132:           onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
133:         >
134:           {/* Search Input */}
135:           <div
136:             className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-4 border-b ${darkMode ? "border-[#2A2A28]" : "border-[#C4B8A8]/20"}`}
137:           >
138:             <Search size={20} className={t2} />
139:             <input
140:               ref={inputRef}
141:               type="text"
142:               value={query}
143:               onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
144:               placeholder="Search clients, projects, invoices, messages..."
145:               className={`flex-1 bg-transparent text-[15px] focus:outline-none ${t1} placeholder:${t2}`}
146:             />
147:             <button onClick={onClose} className={`p-1 rounded-lg ${hover}`}>
148:               <X size={18} className={t2} />
149:             </button>
150:           </div>
151: 
152:           {/* Results */}
153:           <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
154:             {query.trim() && results.length === 0 && (
155:               <div className="p-8 text-center">
156:                 <p className={`text-[14px] ${t2}`}>
157:                   No results found for "{query}"
158:                 </p>
159:               </div>
160:             )}
161: 
162:             {results.length > 0 && (
163:               <div className="py-2">
164:                 {results.map((result, index) => {
165:                   const Icon = typeIcons[result.type as keyof typeof typeIcons];
166:                   const iconColor =
167:                     typeColors[result.type as keyof typeof typeColors];
168:                   const isSelected = index === selectedIndex;
169: 
170:                   return (
171:                     <button
172:                       key={result.id}
173:                       onClick={() => handleSelect(result)}
174:                       className={`w-full flex items-center gap-4 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors ${
175:                         isSelected ? selected : hover
176:                       }`}
177:                       onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(index)}
178:                     >
179:                       <div className={`flex-shrink-0 ${iconColor}`}>
180:                         <Icon size={18} />
181:                       </div>
182:                       <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
183:                         <p className={`text-[14px] ${t1} font-medium truncate`}>
184:                           {result.title}
185:                         </p>
186:                         {result.subtitle && (
187:                           <p className={`text-[12px] ${t2} truncate`}>
188:                             {result.subtitle}
189:                           </p>
190:                         )}
191:                         {result.description && (
192:                           <p className={`text-[11px] ${t2} truncate mt-0.5`}>
193:                             {result.description}
194:                           </p>
195:                         )}
196:                       </div>
197:                       <ChevronRight size={16} className={t2} />
198:                     </button>
199:                   );
200:                 })}
201:               </div>
202:             )}
203: 
204:             {!query.trim() && (
205:               <div className="p-8 text-center">
206:                 <Search size={40} className={`${t2} mx-auto mb-3 opacity-50`} />
207:                 <p className={`text-[14px] ${t1} font-medium mb-1`}>
208:                   Quick Search
209:                 </p>
210:                 <p className={`text-[12px] ${t2}`}>
211:                   Search for clients, projects, invoices, messages, bookings,
212:                   and more...
213:                 </p>
214:                 <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
215:                   <kbd
216:                     className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] ${darkMode ? "bg-[#2A2A28]" : "bg-[#F5F4F0]"} ${t2} font-mono`}
217:                   >
218:                     ↑↓
219:                   </kbd>
220:                   <span className={`text-[11px] ${t2}`}>Navigate</span>
221:                   <kbd
222:                     className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] ${darkMode ? "bg-[#2A2A28]" : "bg-[#F5F4F0]"} ${t2} font-mono ml-2`}
223:                   >
224:                     Enter
225:                   </kbd>
226:                   <span className={`text-[11px] ${t2}`}>Select</span>
227:                   <kbd
228:                     className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] ${darkMode ? "bg-[#2A2A28]" : "bg-[#F5F4F0]"} ${t2} font-mono ml-2`}
229:                   >
230:                     Esc
231:                   </kbd>
232:                   <span className={`text-[11px] ${t2}`}>Close</span>
233:                 </div>
234:               </div>
235:             )}
236:           </div>
237:         </motion.div>
238:       </motion.div>
239:     </AnimatePresence>
240:   );
241: }

418:     "🅱️",
419:     "🆎",
420:     "🆑",
421:     "🅾️",
422:     "🆘",
423:     "❌",
424:     "⭕",
425:     "🛑",
426:   ],
427: };
428: 
429: interface EmojiPickerProps {
430:   onEmojiSelect: (emoji: string) => void;
431:   isOpen: boolean;
432:   onClose: () => void;
433:   darkMode: boolean;
434: }
435: 
436: export function EmojiPicker({
437:   onEmojiSelect,
438:   isOpen,
439:   onClose,
440:   darkMode,
441: }: EmojiPickerProps) {
442:   const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState("Smileys & People");
443:   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
444:   const pickerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
445: 
446:   // Close picker when clicking outside
447:   useEffect(() => {
448:     const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
449:       if (
450:         pickerRef.current &&
451:         !pickerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)
452:       ) {
453:         onClose();
454:       }
455:     };
456: 
457:     if (isOpen) {
458:       document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
459:     }
460: 
461:     return () => {
462:       document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
463:     };
464:   }, [isOpen, onClose]);
465: 
466:   const handleEmojiClick = (emoji: string) => {
467:     onEmojiSelect(emoji);
468:     onClose();
469:   };
470: 
471:   const filteredEmojis = searchQuery
472:     ? Object.values(emojiCategories)
473:         .flat()
474:         .filter(
475:           (emoji) => emoji.includes(searchQuery), // Simple search - could be enhanced with emoji names
476:         )
477:     : emojiCategories[activeCategory as keyof typeof emojiCategories];
478: 
479:   const cardBg = darkMode
480:     ? "bg-[#1C1C1A] border-[#2A2A28]"
481:     : "bg-white border-[#C4B8A8]/20";
482:   const textPrimary = darkMode ? "text-[#F0EEE9]" : "text-[#1E1E1C]";
483:   const textSecondary = darkMode ? "text-[#8A8A82]" : "text-[#6B6B65]";
484:   const hoverBg = darkMode ? "hover:bg-[#2A2A28]" : "hover:bg-[#F5F4F0]";
485:   const activeBg = darkMode ? "bg-[#4A8C5C]" : "bg-[#1C4A3A]";
486: 
487:   return (
488:     <AnimatePresence>
489:       {isOpen && (
490:         <motion.div
491:           ref={pickerRef}
492:           initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.95 }}
493:           animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
494:           exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.95 }}
495:           className={`absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-2 w-80 h-96 ${cardBg} border rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden z-50`}
496:         >
497:           {/* Search */}
498:           <div className="p-4 border-b border-opacity-20">
499:             <div
500:               className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg ${darkMode ? "bg-[#2A2A28]" : "bg-[#F5F4F0]"}`}
501:             >
502:               <Search size={16} className={textSecondary} />
503:               <input
504:                 value={searchQuery}
505:                 onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
506:                 placeholder="Search emojis..."
507:                 className={`flex-1 bg-transparent text-[13px] focus:outline-none ${textPrimary} placeholder:${textSecondary}`}
508:               />
509:             </div>
510:           </div>
511: 
512:           {/* Categories */}
513:           {!searchQuery && (
514:             <div className="flex overflow-x-auto px-4 py-2 border-b border-opacity-20 scrollbar-hide">
515:               {Object.keys(emojiCategories).map((category) => (
516:                 <button
517:                   key={category}
518:                   onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category)}
519:                   className={`flex-shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium rounded-full mr-2 transition-colors ${
520:                     activeCategory === category
521:                       ? `${activeBg} text-white`
522:                       : `${hoverBg} ${textSecondary}`
523:                   }`}
524:                 >
525:                   {category.split(" ")[0]}
526:                 </button>
527:               ))}
528:             </div>
529:           )}
530: 
531:           {/* Emoji Grid */}
532:           <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto">
533:             <div className="grid grid-cols-8 gap-1">
534:               {filteredEmojis.map((emoji, index) => (
535:                 <button
536:                   key={`${emoji}-${index}`}
537:                   onClick={() => handleEmojiClick(emoji)}
538:                   className={`w-8 h-8 text-lg ${hoverBg} rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center`}
539:                   title={emoji}
540:                 >
541:                   {emoji}
542:                 </button>
543:               ))}
544:             </div>
545:           </div>
546:         </motion.div>
547:       )}
548:     </AnimatePresence>
549:   );
550: }
````

 24: export function FullScreenScrollFX({

 43:       img.onload = img.onerror = () => {
 44:         loaded++;
 45:         if (loaded >= total) setImagesLoaded(true);
 46:       };
 47:     });
 48:     // Fallback: mark loaded after 3s even if images haven't loaded
 49:     const fallback = setTimeout(() => setImagesLoaded(true), 3000);
 50:     return () => clearTimeout(fallback);
 51:   }, [sections]);
 52: 
 53:   useEffect(() => {
 54:     if (!containerRef.current || !imagesLoaded) return;
 55: 
 56:     const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
 57:       const totalSections = sections.length;
 58:       // The container height determines the scrollable range
 59:       // Each section gets 100vh of scroll distance
 60:       const trigger = ScrollTrigger.create({
 61:         trigger: containerRef.current,
 62:         start: "top top",
 63:         end: `+=${totalSections * 100}%`,
 64:         pin: true,
 65:         scrub: 0.5,
 66:         snap: {
 67:           snapTo: 1 / (totalSections - 1),
 68:           duration: { min: 0.3, max: (durations.snap ?? 800) / 1000 },
 69:           ease: "power2.inOut",
 70:         },
 71:         onUpdate: (self) => {
 72:           const progress = self.progress;
 73:           const newIndex = Math.round(progress * (totalSections - 1));
 74:           setActiveIndex(Math.min(newIndex, totalSections - 1));
 75:         },
 76:       });
 77: 
 78:       return () => {
 79:         trigger.kill();
 80:       };
 81:     }, containerRef);

 83:     return () => ctx.revert();

 98:             key={activeIndex}

100:             initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.1 }}

102:             exit={{ opacity: 0 }}

104:           >
105:             <img

107:               alt=""

109:             />

111:           </motion.div>
112:         </AnimatePresence>

114: 
115:       {/* Header overlay */}
116:       {header && (
117:         <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 z-20 flex items-center justify-center pt-24 md:pt-28 pointer-events-none">
118:           <div className="pointer-events-auto">{header}</div>
119:         </div>
120:       )}
121: 
122:       {/* Left label */}
123:       <div className="absolute left-6 md:left-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 hidden lg:flex items-center">
124:         <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
125:           <motion.span

128:             style={{ writingMode: "vertical-rl", transform: "rotate(180deg)" }}
129:             initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }}

133:           >
134:             {currentSection.leftLabel}
135:           </motion.span>
136:         </AnimatePresence>
137:       </div>
138: 
139:       {/* Right label */}
140:       <div className="absolute right-6 md:right-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 hidden lg:flex items-center">
141:         <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
142:           <motion.span
143:             key={`right-${activeIndex}`}
144:             className="text-[#F2F0EB]/70 font-[Cormorant_Garamond] text-[15px]"
145:             style={{ writingMode: "vertical-rl" }}
146:             initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 10 }}
147:             animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
148:             exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }}
149:             transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
150:           >
151:             {currentSection.rightLabel}
152:           </motion.span>
153:         </AnimatePresence>
154:       </div>
155: 
156:       {/* Center title — static when centerContent provided, per-slide otherwise */}
157:       <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-center px-6">
158:         {centerContent ? (

165:             {centerContent}

## File: src/app/components/shared/GlareCard.tsx
````typescript
 1: import { useRef, useState } from "react";
 2: import { motion } from "motion/react";
 3: 
 4: interface GlareCardProps {
 5:   image: string;
 6:   title: string;
 7:   description: string;
 8:   category: string;
 9:   onClick?: () => void;
10: }
11: 
12: export function GlareCard({ image, title, description, category, onClick }: GlareCardProps) {
13:   const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
14:   const [rotateX, setRotateX] = useState(0);
15:   const [rotateY, setRotateY] = useState(0);
16:   const [glarePos, setGlarePos] = useState({ x: 50, y: 50 });
17:   const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);
18: 
19:   const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
20:     if (!cardRef.current) return;
21:     const rect = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
22:     const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
23:     const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
24:     setRotateX((y - 0.5) * -12);
25:     setRotateY((x - 0.5) * 12);
26:     setGlarePos({ x: x * 100, y: y * 100 });
27:   };
28: 
29:   const handleMouseLeave = () => {
30:     setRotateX(0);
31:     setRotateY(0);
32:     setIsHovered(false);
33:   };
34: 
35:   return (
36:     <motion.div
37:       ref={cardRef}
38:       onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
39:       onMouseEnter={() => setIsHovered(true)}
40:       onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
41:       onClick={onClick}
42:       className="relative rounded-[20px] bg-[#FAFAF7] overflow-hidden cursor-pointer group"
43:       style={{
44:         transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
45:         perspective: 1000,
46:         boxShadow: "0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)",
47:       }}
48:       animate={{
49:         rotateX,
50:         rotateY,
51:         scale: isHovered ? 1.02 : 1,
52:       }}
53:       transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 30 }}
54:     >
55:       {/* Image */}
56:       <div className="relative h-56 md:h-64 overflow-hidden">
57:         <img
58:           src={image}
59:           alt={title}
60:           className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-110"
61:         />
62:         <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/20 to-transparent" />
63:       </div>
64: 
65:       {/* Content */}
66:       <div className="p-6">
67:         <span className="text-[#8A9E8C] text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">{category}</span>
68:         <h3 className="text-[#1C4A3A] mt-1" style={{ fontSize: "1.4rem" }}>{title}</h3>
69:         <p className="text-[#6B6B65] text-[14px] mt-2 leading-relaxed">{description}</p>
70:         <span className="inline-block mt-4 text-[#8A9E8C] text-[13px] group-hover:text-[#1C4A3A] transition-colors duration-300">
71:           Explore &rarr;
72:         </span>
73:       </div>
74: 
75:       {/* Glare effect */}
76:       {isHovered && (
77:         <div
78:           className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-300"
79:           style={{
80:             background: `radial-gradient(circle at ${glarePos.x}% ${glarePos.y}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 0%, transparent 60%)`,
81:           }}
82:         />
83:       )}
84:     </motion.div>
85:   );
86: }
````

## File: src/app/components/shared/ScrollReveal.tsx
````typescript
 1: import { useRef, useEffect, type ReactNode } from "react";
 2: import gsap from "gsap";
 3: import { ScrollTrigger } from "gsap/ScrollTrigger";
 4: 
 5: gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
 6: 
 7: interface ScrollRevealProps {
 8:   children: ReactNode;
 9:   className?: string;
10:   delay?: number;
11: }
12: 
13: export function ScrollReveal({ children, className = "", delay = 0 }: ScrollRevealProps) {
14:   const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
15: 
16:   useEffect(() => {
17:     if (!ref.current) return;
18: 
19:     const trigger = gsap.fromTo(
20:       ref.current,
21:       { opacity: 0, y: 40 },
22:       {
23:         opacity: 1,
24:         y: 0,
25:         duration: 0.8,
26:         delay,
27:         ease: "power3.out",
28:         scrollTrigger: {
29:           trigger: ref.current,
30:           start: "top 90%",
31:           once: true,
32:         },
33:       }
34:     );
35: 
36:     return () => {
37:       if (trigger.scrollTrigger) {
38:         trigger.scrollTrigger.kill();
39:       }
40:       trigger.kill();
41:     };
42:   }, [delay]);
43: 
44:   return (
45:     <div ref={ref} className={className} style={{ opacity: 0 }}>
46:       {children}
47:     </div>
48:   );
49: }
````

## File: src/app/components/shared/TextRotate.tsx
````typescript
  1: import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
  2: import { AnimatePresence, motion, LayoutGroup } from "motion/react";
  3: 
  4: interface TextRotateProps {
  5:   texts: string[];
  6:   rotationInterval?: number;
  7:   mainClassName?: string;
  8:   splitLevelClassName?: string;
  9:   staggerFrom?: "first" | "last" | "center";
 10:   staggerDuration?: number;
 11:   initial?: Record<string, unknown>;
 12:   animate?: Record<string, unknown>;
 13:   exit?: Record<string, unknown>;
 14:   transition?: Record<string, unknown>;
 15:   /* Legacy API compat */
 16:   words?: string[];
 17:   interval?: number;
 18:   className?: string;
 19: }
 20: 
 21: export function TextRotate({
 22:   texts,
 23:   rotationInterval = 2500,
 24:   mainClassName = "",
 25:   splitLevelClassName = "",
 26:   staggerFrom = "last",
 27:   staggerDuration = 0.025,
 28:   initial = { y: "100%" },
 29:   animate = { y: 0 },
 30:   exit = { y: "-120%" },
 31:   transition = { type: "spring", damping: 30, stiffness: 400 },
 32:   /* Legacy compat */
 33:   words,
 34:   interval,
 35:   className = "",
 36: }: TextRotateProps) {
 37:   // Support legacy API
 38:   const allTexts = texts ?? words ?? [];
 39:   const effectiveInterval = rotationInterval ?? interval ?? 2500;
 40: 
 41:   const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
 42: 
 43:   useEffect(() => {
 44:     if (allTexts.length <= 1) return;
 45:     const timer = setInterval(() => {
 46:       setIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % allTexts.length);
 47:     }, effectiveInterval);
 48:     return () => clearInterval(timer);
 49:   }, [allTexts.length, effectiveInterval]);
 50: 
 51:   const currentText = allTexts[index] || "";
 52:   const chars = currentText.split("");
 53: 
 54:   const getStaggerDelay = (charIndex: number, total: number) => {
 55:     if (staggerFrom === "last") return (total - 1 - charIndex) * staggerDuration;
 56:     if (staggerFrom === "center") return Math.abs(charIndex - Math.floor(total / 2)) * staggerDuration;
 57:     return charIndex * staggerDuration;
 58:   };
 59: 
 60:   return (
 61:     <span className={`inline-flex ${className}`}>
 62:       <LayoutGroup>
 63:         <motion.span
 64:           className="inline-flex whitespace-pre"
 65:           layout
 66:           transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 30, stiffness: 400 }}
 67:         >
 68:           <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
 69:             <motion.span
 70:               key={currentText}
 71:               className={`inline-flex overflow-hidden ${mainClassName}`}
 72:               initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
 73:               animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
 74:               exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
 75:               transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
 76:             >
 77:               {chars.map((char, i) => (
 78:                 <motion.span
 79:                   key={`${currentText}-${i}`}
 80:                   className={`inline-block overflow-hidden ${splitLevelClassName}`}
 81:                 >
 82:                   <motion.span
 83:                     className="inline-block"
 84:                     initial={initial}
 85:                     animate={animate}
 86:                     exit={exit}
 87:                     transition={{
 88:                       ...transition,
 89:                       delay: getStaggerDelay(i, chars.length),
 90:                     }}
 91:                   >
 92:                     {char === " " ? "\u00A0" : char}
 93:                   </motion.span>
 94:                 </motion.span>
 95:               ))}
 96:             </motion.span>
 97:           </AnimatePresence>
 98:         </motion.span>
 99:       </LayoutGroup>
100:     </span>
101:   );
102: }
````

 54:   const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
 55:     {
 56:       ...opts,
 57:       axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
 58:     },
 59:     plugins,
 60:   );
 61:   const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false);
 62:   const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false);
 63: 
 64:   const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {

 69:

 56:         data-chart={chartId}

 58:           "[&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-hidden [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-hidden [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-hidden",
 59:           className,
 60:         )}
 61:         {...props}
 62:       >
 63:         <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
 64:         <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
 65:           {children}
 66:         </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
 67:       </div>
 68:     </ChartContext.Provider>
 69:   );
 70: }
 71: 
 72: const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
 73:   const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(
 74:     ([, config]) => config.theme || config.color,
 75:   );
 76: 
 77:   if (!colorConfig.length) {
 78:     return null;
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   return (
 82:     <style
 83:       dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
 84:         __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
 85:           .map(
 86:             ([theme, prefix]) => `
 87: ${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
 88: ${colorConfig
 89:   .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
 90:     const color =
 91:       itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] ||
 92:       itemConfig.color;
 93:     return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null;
 94:   })
 95:   .join("\n")}
 96: }
 97: `,
 98:           )
 99:           .join("\n"),
100:       }}
101:     />
102:   );
103: };
104: 
105: const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip;
106: 
107: function ChartTooltipContent({
108:   active,
109:   payload,
110:   className,
111:   indicator = "dot",
112:   hideLabel = false,
113:   hideIndicator = false,
114:   label,
115:   labelFormatter,
116:   labelClassName,
117:   formatter,
118:   color,
119:   nameKey,
120:   labelKey,
121: }: React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &
122:   React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
123:     hideLabel?: boolean;
124:     hideIndicator?: boolean;
125:     indicator?: "line" | "dot" | "dashed";
126:     nameKey?: string;
127:     labelKey?: string;
128:   }) {
129:   const { config } = useChart();
130: 
131:   const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
132:     if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
133:       return null;
134:     }
135: 
136:     const [item] = payload;
137:     const key = `${labelKey || item?.dataKey || item?.name || "value"}`;
138:     const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
139:     const value =
140:       !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
141:         ? config[label as keyof typeof config]?.label || label
142:         : itemConfig?.label;
143: 
144:     if (labelFormatter) {
145:       return (
146:         <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
147:           {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
148:         </div>
149:       );
150:     }
151: 
152:     if (!value) {
153:       return null;
154:     }
155: 
156:     return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>;
157:   }, [
158:     label,
159:     labelFormatter,
160:     payload,
161:     hideLabel,
162:     labelClassName,
163:     config,
164:     labelKey,
165:   ]);
166: 
167:   if (!active || !payload?.length) {
168:     return null;
169:   }
170: 
171:   const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot";
172: 
173:   return (
174:     <div
175:       className={cn(
176:         "border-border/50 bg-background grid min-w-[8rem] items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
177:         className,
178:       )}
179:     >
180:       {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
181:       <div className="grid gap-1.5">
182:         {payload.map((item, index) => {
183:           const key = `${nameKey || item.name || item.dataKey || "value"}`;
184:           const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
185:           const indicatorColor = color || item.payload.fill || item.color;
186: 
187:           return (
188:             <div
189:               key={item.dataKey}
190:               className={cn(
191:                 "[&>svg]:text-muted-foreground flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5",
192:                 indicator === "dot" && "items-center",
193:               )}
194:             >
195:               {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
196:                 formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
197:               ) : (
198:                 <>
199:                   {itemConfig?.icon ? (
200:                     <itemConfig.icon />
201:                   ) : (
202:                     !hideIndicator && (
203:                       <div
204:                         className={cn(
205:                           "shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-bg)",
206:                           {
207:                             "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
208:                             "w-1": indicator === "line",
209:                             "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
210:                               indicator === "dashed",
211:                             "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
212:                           },
213:                         )}
214:                         style={
215:                           {
216:                             "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
217:                             "--color-border": indicatorColor,
218:                           } as React.CSSProperties
219:                         }
220:                       />
221:                     )
222:                   )}
223:                   <div
224:                     className={cn(
225:                       "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
226:                       nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center",
227:                     )}
228:                   >
229:                     <div className="grid gap-1.5">
230:                       {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
231:                       <span className="text-muted-foreground">
232:                         {itemConfig?.label || item.name}
233:                       </span>
234:                     </div>
235:                     {item.value && (
236:                       <span className="text-foreground font-mono font-medium tabular-nums">
237:                         {item.value.toLocaleString()}
238:                       </span>
239:                     )}
240:                   </div>
241:                 </>
242:               )}
243:             </div>
244:           );
245:         })}
246:       </div>
247:     </div>
248:   );
249: }
250: 
251: const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend;
252: 
253: function ChartLegendContent({
254:   className,
255:   hideIcon = false,
256:   payload,
257:   verticalAlign = "bottom",
258:   nameKey,
259: }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> &
260:   Pick<RechartsPrimitive.LegendProps, "payload" | "verticalAlign"> & {
261:     hideIcon?: boolean;
262:     nameKey?: string;
263:   }) {
264:   const { config } = useChart();
265: 
266:   if (!payload?.length) {
267:     return null;
268:   }
269: 
270:   return (
271:     <div
272:       className={cn(
273:         "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
274:         verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
275:         className,
276:       )}
277:     >
278:       {payload.map((item) => {
279:         const key = `${nameKey || item.dataKey || "value"}`;
280:         const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
281: 
282:         return (
283:           <div
284:             key={item.value}
285:             className={cn(
286:               "[&>svg]:text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3",
287:             )}
288:           >
289:             {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
290:               <itemConfig.icon />
291:             ) : (
292:               <div
293:                 className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
294:                 style={{
295:                   backgroundColor: item.color,
296:                 }}
297:               />
298:             )}
299:             {itemConfig?.label}
300:           </div>
301:         );
302:       })}
303:     </div>
304:   );
305: }
306: 
307: // Helper to extract item config from a payload.
308: function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
309:   config: ChartConfig,
310:   payload: unknown,
311:   key: string,
312: ) {
313:   if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
314:     return undefined;
315:   }
316: 
317:   const payloadPayload =
318:     "payload" in payload &&
319:     typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
320:     payload.payload !== null
321:       ? payload.payload
322:       : undefined;
323: 
324:   let configLabelKey: string = key;
325: 
326:   if (
327:     key in payload &&
328:     typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string"
329:   ) {
330:     configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string;
331:   } else if (
332:     payloadPayload &&
333:     key in payloadPayload &&
334:     typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
335:   ) {
336:     configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
337:       key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
338:     ] as string;
339:   }
340: 
341:   return configLabelKey in config
342:     ? config[configLabelKey]
343:     : config[key as keyof typeof config];
344: }
345: 
346: export {
347:   ChartContainer,
348:   ChartTooltip,
349:   ChartTooltipContent,
350:   ChartLegend,
351:   ChartLegendContent,
352:   ChartStyle,
353: };
````

````typescript
  1: "use client";

  3: import * as React from "react";
  4: import * as LabelPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-label";

 10:   useFormState,

 12:   type FieldPath,
 13:   type FieldValues,
 14: } from "react-hook-form";
 15: 
 16: import { cn } from "./utils";
 17: import { Label } from "./label";
 18: 
 19: const Form = FormProvider;
 20: 
 21: type FormFieldContextValue<
 22:   TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
 23:   TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
 24: > = {
 25:   name: TName;
 26: };
 27: 
 28: const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue>(
 29:   {} as FormFieldContextValue,
 30: );
 31: 
 32: const FormField = <
 33:   TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
 34:   TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
 35: >({
 36:   ...props
 37: }: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
 38:   return (
 39:     <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
 40:       <Controller {...props} />
 41:     </FormFieldContext.Provider>
 42:   );
 43: };
 44: 
 45: const useFormField = () => {
 46:   const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext);
 47:   const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext);
 48:   const { getFieldState } = useFormContext();
 49:   const formState = useFormState({ name: fieldContext.name });
 50:   const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState);
 51: 
 52:   if (!fieldContext) {
 53:     throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>");
 54:   }
 55: 
 56:   const { id } = itemContext;
 57: 
 58:   return {
 59:     id,
 60:     name: fieldContext.name,
 61:     formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
 62:     formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
 63:     formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
 64:     ...fieldState,
 65:   };
 66: };
 67: 
 68: type FormItemContextValue = {
 69:   id: string;
 70: };
 71: 
 72: const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue>(
 73:   {} as FormItemContextValue,
 74: );
 75: 
 76: function FormItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
 77:   const id = React.useId();
 78: 
 79:   return (
 80:     <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
 81:       <div
 82:         data-slot="form-item"
 83:         className={cn("grid gap-2", className)}
 84:         {...props}
 85:       />
 86:     </FormItemContext.Provider>
 87:   );
 88: }
 89: 
 90: function FormLabel({
 91:   className,
 92:   ...props
 93: }: React.ComponentProps<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>) {
 94:   const { error, formItemId } = useFormField();
 95: 
 96:   return (
 97:     <Label
 98:       data-slot="form-label"
 99:       data-error={!!error}
100:       className={cn("data-[error=true]:text-destructive", className)}
101:       htmlFor={formItemId}
102:       {...props}
103:     />
104:   );
105: }
106: 
107: function FormControl({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Slot>) {
108:   const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } =
109:     useFormField();
110: 
111:   return (
112:     <Slot
113:       data-slot="form-control"
114:       id={formItemId}
115:       aria-describedby={
116:         !error
117:           ? `${formDescriptionId}`
118:           : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
119:       }
120:       aria-invalid={!!error}
121:       {...props}
122:     />
123:   );
124: }
125: 
126: function FormDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
127:   const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField();
128: 
129:   return (
130:     <p
131:       data-slot="form-description"
132:       id={formDescriptionId}
133:       className={cn("text-muted-foreground text-sm", className)}
134:       {...props}
135:     />
136:   );
137: }
138: 
139: function FormMessage({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
140:   const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField();
141:   const body = error ? String(error?.message ?? "") : props.children;
142: 
143:   if (!body) {
144:     return null;
145:   }
146: 
147:   return (
148:     <p
149:       data-slot="form-message"
150:       id={formMessageId}
151:       className={cn("text-destructive text-sm", className)}
152:       {...props}
153:     >
154:       {body}
155:     </p>
156:   );
157: }
158: 
159: export {
160:   useFormField,
161:   Form,
162:   FormItem,
163:   FormLabel,
164:   FormControl,
165:   FormDescription,
166:   FormMessage,
167:   FormField,
168: };

## File: src/app/components/ui/use-mobile.ts
````typescript
 1: import * as React from "react";
 2: 
 3: const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768;
 4: 
 5: export function useIsMobile() {
 6:   const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(
 7:     undefined,
 8:   );
 9: 
10:   React.useEffect(() => {
11:     const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`);
12:     const onChange = () => {
13:       setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
14:     };
15:     mql.addEventListener("change", onChange);
16:     setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
17:     return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
18:   }, []);
19: 
20:   return !!isMobile;
21: }
````

280: /**
281:  * Fuzzy search function - matches if all characters of query appear in order in the text
282:  */
283: export function fuzzyMatch(text: string, query: string): boolean {
284:   const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
285:   const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
286: 
287:   let queryIndex = 0;
288:   for (let i = 0; i < lowerText.length && queryIndex < lowerQuery.length; i++) {
289:     if (lowerText[i] === lowerQuery[queryIndex]) {
290:       queryIndex++;
291:     }
292:   }
293: 
294:   return queryIndex === lowerQuery.length;
295: }
296: 
297: /**
298:  * Search through all data with fuzzy matching
299:  */
300: export function searchData(query: string): SearchResult[] {
301:   if (!query.trim()) {
302:     return [];
303:   }
304: 
305:   return searchableData.filter((item) => {
306:     const searchableText = `${item.title} ${item.subtitle || ""} ${item.description || ""}`;
307:     return fuzzyMatch(searchableText, query);
308:   });
309: }
````

## File: src/app/hooks/useDarkMode.ts
````typescript
 1: import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
 2: 
 3: const STORAGE_KEY = "enzo_dark_mode";
 4: 
 5: export function useDarkMode(defaultDark = false): [boolean, () => void] {
 6:   const [darkMode, setDarkMode] = useState<boolean>(() => {
 7:     try {
 8:       const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
 9:       if (stored !== null) return stored === "true";
10:     } catch {
11:       // localStorage unavailable
12:     }
13:     return defaultDark;
14:   });
15: 
16:   useEffect(() => {
17:     try {
18:       localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(darkMode));
19:     } catch {
20:       // localStorage unavailable
21:     }
22:   }, [darkMode]);
23: 
24:   const toggleDarkMode = () => setDarkMode((prev) => !prev);
25: 
26:   return [darkMode, toggleDarkMode];
27: }
````

## File: src/app/hooks/useNotifications.ts
````typescript
 1: import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
 2: 
 3: export type NotificationType =
 4:   | "message"
 5:   | "invoice"
 6:   | "appointment"
 7:   | "design"
 8:   | "enquiry";
 9: 
10: export interface AppNotification {
11:   id: number;
12:   type: NotificationType;
13:   text: string;
14:   time: string;
15:   read: boolean;
16: }
17: 
18: const SIMULATED_POOL: Omit<AppNotification, "id" | "time" | "read">[] = [
19:   { type: "message", text: "New message from Sarah Thompson" },
20:   { type: "invoice", text: "Invoice INV-007 is due in 3 days" },
21:   { type: "appointment", text: "Appointment reminder: tomorrow at 10am" },
22:   { type: "design", text: "New design renders are ready to review" },
23:   { type: "enquiry", text: "New enquiry from James Patel" },
24:   { type: "message", text: "Hannah Green replied to your message" },
25:   { type: "design", text: "Your 3D kitchen design is ready" },
26:   { type: "appointment", text: "Consultation scheduled for next Monday" },
27: ];
28: 
29: let nextId = 100;
30: 
31: function relativeTime(date: Date): string {
32:   const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - date.getTime()) / 1000);
33:   if (diff < 60) return "just now";
34:   if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)} min ago`;
35:   if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)}h ago`;
36:   return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400)}d ago`;
37: }
38: 
39: export function useNotifications(
40:   initialNotifications: Omit<AppNotification, "id">[] = [],
41:   simulateInterval = 180_000, // 3 minutes
42: ) {
43:   const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<AppNotification[]>(() =>
44:     initialNotifications.map((n, i) => ({ ...n, id: i + 1 })),
45:   );
46: 
47:   useEffect(() => {
48:     if (simulateInterval <= 0) return;
49:     const timer = setInterval(() => {
50:       const randomItem =
51:         SIMULATED_POOL[Math.floor(Math.random() * SIMULATED_POOL.length)];
52:       const newNotif: AppNotification = {
53:         ...randomItem,
54:         id: ++nextId,
55:         time: relativeTime(new Date()),
56:         read: false,
57:       };
58:       setNotifications((prev) => [newNotif, ...prev]);
59:     }, simulateInterval);
60:     return () => clearInterval(timer);
61:   }, [simulateInterval]);
62: 
63:   const markRead = useCallback((id: number) => {
64:     setNotifications((prev) =>
65:       prev.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n)),
66:     );
67:   }, []);
68: 
69:   const markAllRead = useCallback(() => {
70:     setNotifications((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, read: true })));
71:   }, []);
72: 
73:   const unreadCount = notifications.filter((n) => !n.read).length;
74: 
75:   return { notifications, markRead, markAllRead, unreadCount };
76: }
````

 4:  * Custom hook to set the page title dynamically
 5:  * @param title - The title to set for the page
 6:  */
 7: export function usePageTitle(title: string) {
 8:   useEffect(() => {

14:     };

## File: src/app/hooks/useScrollToTop.ts
````typescript
 1: import { useEffect } from "react";
 2: import { useLocation } from "react-router";
 3: 
 4: interface UseScrollToTopOptions {
 5:   smooth?: boolean;
 6:   delay?: number;
 7:   enabled?: boolean;
 8: }
 9: 
10: /**
11:  * Custom hook that scrolls to the top of the page when the route changes.
12:  *
13:  * @param options - Configuration options for scroll behavior
14:  * @param options.smooth - Use smooth scrolling animation (default: false)
15:  * @param options.delay - Delay in milliseconds before scrolling (default: 0)
16:  * @param options.enabled - Enable/disable the scroll behavior (default: true)
17:  *
18:  * @example
19:  * ```tsx
20:  * // Basic usage
21:  * useScrollToTop();
22:  *
23:  * // With smooth scrolling
24:  * useScrollToTop({ smooth: true });
25:  *
26:  * // With delay
27:  * useScrollToTop({ delay: 100 });
28:  * ```
29:  */
30: export function useScrollToTop(options: UseScrollToTopOptions = {}) {
31:   const { smooth = false, delay = 0, enabled = true } = options;
32:   const location = useLocation();
33: 
34:   useEffect(() => {
35:     if (!enabled) return;
36: 
37:     const scrollToTop = () => {
38:       window.scrollTo({
39:         top: 0,
40:         left: 0,
41:         behavior: smooth ? "smooth" : "auto",
42:       });
43:     };
44: 
45:     if (delay > 0) {
46:       const timeoutId = setTimeout(scrollToTop, delay);
47:       return () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
48:     } else {
49:       scrollToTop();
50:     }
51:   }, [location.pathname, location.search, smooth, delay, enabled]);
52: }
````

## File: src/imports/website-components.md
````markdown
 1: 🌐 MAIN WEBSITE — Use These
 2: ✅ MUST USE
 3: #	Component	Where to Use	Notes
 4: 9	Full Screen Scroll FX	Hero / Homepage	Your most-liked one
 5: ​ — React + GSAP full-screen sections with sidebar labels and scroll-triggered transitions. Use Enzo's project photography as backgrounds. Absolutely premium feel.
 6: 7	Text Rotate	Hero tagline	Animates a rotating word inline e.g. "Bespoke Kitchens" → "Bespoke Bedrooms" → "Bespoke Spaces"
 7: ​. Perfect for hero headline.
 8: 18	Testimonials Columns	Reviews section	Animated auto-scrolling masonry columns of client reviews
 9: ​. Looks stunning and works perfectly with Enzo's Google review content. Adapt colours to warm cream.
10: 15	Glare Card	Services / Portfolio cards	3D tilt + glare effect on hover
11: ​. Use for Kitchen, Bedroom, Media Wall, Wardrobe service cards. Replace dark card with Enzo's warm neutral tones.
12: 1	Hover Footer	Site Footer	Large animated letter reveal on hover
13: ​ — elegant and memorable for a luxury brand. Replace dark theme with Enzo's cream/sage palette.
14: 17	Particle Text Effect	About page or loading screen	Interactive canvas-based particle text
15: ​ — right-click to scatter particles, auto-changes words. Use for "ENZO INTERIORS" or "BESPOKE DESIGN" — very wow-factor.
16: 19	Page Not Found 404	404 Error Page	Clean split-screen dark silhouette design
17: ​. Looks sharp, professional. Adapt branding to Enzo.
18: 10	Footer Taped Design	Alternative Footer option	Minimalist footer with tape-design accents
19: ​. Great clean option if hover footer feels too bold.
20: ✅ RECOMMENDED
21: #	Component	Where to Use	Notes
22: 4	Menu Toggle Icon	Navbar hamburger	Smooth animated hamburger → X transition for mobile nav. Essential for mobile UX.
23: 5	Social Icons	Footer / Contact page	Styled social media icons for Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp.
24: 8	Link Preview	Blog / Inspiration page	Hover over a link and see a live preview card pop up. Great for the blog/inspiration section.
25: 2	Toast	Site-wide notifications	Clean toast for "Booking confirmed", "Message sent" etc.
26: ​ Use across entire site.
27: 🖥️ CLIENT PORTAL — Use These
28: The portal vision is a custom OS-like feel with a dock, light/dark mode, and premium dashboard UI.
29: 
30: ✅ MUST USE
31: #	Component	Where to Use	Notes
32: 12	Dock (Two)	Portal sidebar/bottom nav	macOS-style animated Dock with Framer Motion
33: ​ — icons expand on hover. This IS the OS feel you want. Dark mode: dark pill dock. Light mode: frosted glass dock. Use for: Dashboard, Projects, Messages, Files, Invoices, Settings
34: 6	Floating Nav / Dock (bundled/1428)	Portal top or bottom bar	A second floating pill nav
35: ​ — use this for quick-access portal actions (Home, Notifications, Settings, Profile, Logout)
36: 3	Full Screen Signup	Portal Login page	Split-screen login/signup
37: ​ — left panel uses Enzo's project imagery (dark luxury overlay), right panel has clean form. Looks like a premium SaaS login.
38: 11	Cybernetic Bento Grid	Portal Dashboard	Feature-card bento grid layout
39: ​ — adapt for Project Status, Upcoming Appointments, Outstanding Invoice, Messages Unread, Documents. Light and dark mode both work beautifully.
40: 13	Bundled/969	Portal context/action menu	Small floating action pill with dot indicator (seen in screenshot
41: ​) — ideal for quick-action menus per project card.
42: 16	Bundled/625	Portal CTA buttons	Styled pill buttons with solid/normal/ghost states
43: ​ — use consistently for all portal CTAs.
44: 14	Pulse Beams	Portal Loading or Empty States	Animated pulsing beam lines — use for loading screens, empty states ("No projects yet"), or as a decorative background element on the portal dashboard.
45: 2	Toast	Portal notifications	"Invoice paid", "Booking confirmed", "Design approved", "New message" — toast system used site-wide but especially critical in the portal.
46: 🎨 Colour Matching Guide
47: Since the main site is light only (Enzo's existing warm palette):
48: 
49: Element	Colour
50: Background	#F2F0EB (cream off-white)
51: Primary text	#2C2C2C (warm charcoal)
52: Accent	Sage green / muted olive
53: Cards	#FFFFFF or #FAF9F6
54: CTA Buttons	Deep charcoal or sage green
55: For the portal (light + dark mode):
56: 
57: Mode	Background	Cards	Dock
58: Light	#F5F5F0	#FFFFFF	Frosted glass
59: Dark	#111110	#1C1C1A	Dark pill #1E1E1C
